x: Julie did an excellent job as narrator with Tina co-ordinating the guests and by the sound of the delighted exclamations greeting each arrival it was clear that the idea was an enormous success.

A true sign of our regard for Gwen was that the chapel at Lower Morden was packed with family, friends and club members, many of those present falling into more than one of those categories. We will all miss her and we offer our deepest sympathy to her family, particularly Bill, Tina and David.
Gwen and Bill were married in 1961 and their family was completed with the arrival of Tina and David. Years of family happiness followed of which many people would be envious.
